product.title: STA10 3.5W 3CCT 12V Low Voltage Rectangular Waterproof Horizontal Integrated LED Aluminum Stair Step Light Fixture
product.body_html:
| STA10 Installation Guide |

The STA10 3.5W 12V Modern Step Lights are great for both design and safety! We have the perfect step light fixtures to decorate your stairs as well as walls. This heavy-duty cast aluminum step light comes with a Black, Silver, Dark Bronze or White coated finish. An integrated 3.5W LED offers 3CCT adjustable light color temperature in 3000K Warm White, 4000K Natural White, or 5000K Cool White and illuminates its areas with a cozy and pleasant atmosphere.Perfect for LED stair tread lights, they provide both functional lighting and a stylish touch for your stairways. 

The size of this horizontal LED step light is 2.875 (H) x 4.75” (W) x 1.5” (D). It's the perfect size for a standard bell box, so its location can be pre-installed and wired and ready for the fixture installation. This rectangular step light has a waterproof rating of IP65 so the moist weather won't be a fact to damage. The short cable is connected from its backside for low voltage connection. This high-quality product will serve you greatly.

All low voltage outdoor lights must be installed with a 12V Low Voltage Transformer and connections between lights must be secured using Grease Filled Wire Nuts (WN12) waterproof connectors.
